name: 速成
label: 速

source.words: rime-quick's Quick 5 (LGPL-3.0) on rime-cangjie's dictionary (marked GPL) and rime-essay (LGPL-3.0)

howTo: Type Quick (速成): each character is the first and last keys of its Cangjie code, two at most. Many characters share a code, so you'll pick from the bar more often than in Cangjie.

First, pick your characters on this page: Simplified, Hong Kong or Taiwan. Your code floats above the bar and the choices sit over the top row. Space types the first one, and a tap picks any. For more, press Shift, swipe up on the keys, or tap ⋯. Enter or a swipe turns the page. Next words follow each pick. Enter types the code as letters, and double Space types 。.

guide.line: Cangjie's first and last parts only.
points: Use one or two letters per character. When several characters share a code, pick yours from the bar.
